name: What financing options are available for purchasing a waterfront home in South Florida?

mainEntity.name: What financing options are available for purchasing a waterfront home in South Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing options for waterfront homes in South Florida are similar to traditional properties but may require lenders familiar with the nuances of waterfront collateral and higher insurance requirements. Conventional loans, FHA, VA, and jumbo loans are common, though jumbo loans are frequently used for higher-value waterfront properties. Some lenders specialize in properties with docks or seawalls. Kelby Contreras can connect you with trusted mortgage professionals experienced in lending for waterfront homes in our service areas, such as Pinecrest or Coconut Grove, who understand the specific appraisal and insurance considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Financing includes conventional, FHA, VA, and jumbo loans, with jumbo loans common for high-value waterfronts. Lenders familiar with waterfront collateral and higher insurance are beneficial for these purchases.
